name: Altura maxima de edificacion
description: Vertical distance from natural ground level to the highest point of the building, compared against the maximum height allowed by the Plan Regulador Comunal for the project zone.

max_height_m.description: Maximum building height allowed in the project zone, in meters. Must be set by the user based on the applicable PRC zone. Demo value: 42.0 m (Zone EA12, Providencia).

messages.green: Building height ({measured} m) is within the allowed maximum ({limit} m)
messages.yellow: Building height ({measured} m) is close to the allowed maximum ({limit} m). Verify tolerances.
messages.red: Building height ({measured} m) exceeds the allowed maximum ({limit} m)
